chapters.label: Live: the 2022 semi-final
chapters.text: The 2022 Futsal Champions League semi-final, in Riga. Barça were three nil down to Benfica, but fought back. Four all, extra time. With seconds left, Adolfo scores the winner. Five four!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: This is how he does it. He takes it on the right wing and runs at his defender, fast. A quick fake inside, then he bursts past and shoots early, before the keeper is ready!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Speed at the defender, fake, burst past, shoot early!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: attack your defender at speed, and shoot early!
